thread:
raj_sales: Quick heads-up — Acme partner is ready to run a short co-sell engagement. They want a 2-week technical eval + enablement. Need answers on SSO/SAML, security questionnaire, and pricing for a Dedicated trial. Can someone take point on tech + security?

olivia_se: I can take tech. Two quick Qs: what model family are they validating against, and expected peak qps? That'll determine Dedicated sizing. Also, do we have an internal template for a 2-week trial SOW?

emma_partner: Partner side here — target model is Llama-3-ish (open weights). Peak ~50 rps, burst to 80 for a short window, target p50 latency <200ms. SAML SSO required. I uploaded their security questionnaire here: https://acme.files/sec-questionnaire-2026.pdf — please confirm you can access.

tim_partnerships: I'll prepare the SOW + partner enablement deck. @olivia_se please draft a short runbook for the POC (env setup, smoke tests, rollback). For pricing: do we quote pro-rated dedicated commit or a flat trial rate?

olivia_se: For Dedicated sizing with 50 rps and that model family, plan to use a 1xA10-equivalent pool (auto-scale to 2 under burst). Pricing suggestion: 2-week eval at 50% of the equivalent monthly reserved rate, with a hard cap on spend. I'll run numbers with finance.

olivia_se: Quick arch note — recommended setup: VPC peering to partner, dedicated pool pinned to region, and routing policy with automatic fallback to hosted smaller instance if capacity issues. Sample config snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer-dedicated
  fallback: hosted-small
peering:
  type: vpc
  peer_id: pcx-0abc1234 
  allowlist: ["10.0.0.0/16"]
resources:
  pool: dedicated-1gpu
  autoscale: [1,2]
```

olivia_se: Also add a smoke test: POST /v1/generate with sample prompt, verify token-per-request and latency < 250ms. I'll add the exact curl later.

sec-bot: Automated update — security questionnaire received and triaged. Created ticket SEC-2026-44 for InfoSec review. ETA initial response: 48 business hours.

raj_sales: Can we lock a kickoff call? Suggested: Thursday 10:00am PT (30m) to cover SAML metadata, test accounts, and go/no-go criteria. Also we need the pricing note for legal to approve.

emma_partner: 10:00am PT works for us. I'll bring their SSO admin and the product owner. I'll DM the SAML metadata + one test account after the call. :thumbsup:

olivia_se: I'll create the calendar invite and attach the runbook draft. Action items recap: olivia — runbook + smoke tests; tim — draft SOW + enablement deck; raj — commercial terms for 2-week trial; emma — SAML metadata + test creds; sec-bot — security review in SEC-2026-44. Anyone want to add?

tim_partnerships: All set from my side, will upload SOW draft by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

raj_sales: Great — thanks everyone. We'll sync after the kickoff and update this thread with the finalized pricing and SAML metadata.
